synopsis: A Mie-theory rain and fog lidar model was packaged as an Open Simulation Interface (OSI) functional mock-up unit in research published in Sensors in 2023; this evidence is explicitly on-road, not heavy off-road validation [f6381]. In the tooling chapter, dSPACE AURELION lists an OSI chain alongside software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop interfaces [f9055]. Persival lists OSI, FMU and OpenMATERIAL interfaces and standards, providing another tooling reference but not establishing compatibility with the published lidar model [f9097, f6381].
